findings: DuplicateSet.diff measures length of formatted unified_diff text, not changed byte count. Original function produces126 and115 for reversed synthetic pair. Threshold120 would distinguish orientations; no full CLI outcome established.

check_differences shortcuts content comparison when all hash_raw_body values equal. Injecting same synthetic hash with unequal bodies admits pair; distinct-hash zero-content-threshold control rejects. This establishes absence of byte confirmation in this path, not a real hash collision.

Offending pairs form a graph and high-degree vertices are greedily evicted until remaining pairs satisfy thresholds. This avoids transitive grouping of all near neighbors, but is not a maximum-cardinality subset proof.
Both negative thresholds bypass checks. Otherwise raw body hashes are materialized even with content threshold disabled. Source observation only, no memory benchmark.

Worker hashing reopens file and returns scalar metadata; selection reopens mails with prior memoized timestamp/size. No content snapshot verified across stages in this source. Physical mutation runtime remains unqualified.

Source registration resolves explicit source path and rejects exact duplicate explicit key, but recursively returned subboxes overwrite self.sources entries while incrementing MAIL_FOUND each time. Requires separately reviewed open_box callers for actual overlapping-box reproduction.
